Name: Sora Animation Speed
Description: Desired rate from 0.1x to 3x. Enable the override to apply it to the current Sora Actor. Animation time also controls movement and attack/effect triggers; this changes gameplay timing. The chosen range is a trainer policy, not a native engine limit.
RestoreBehavior: The rate belongs to one current Sora Actor. Disable restores its original float only while the same Actor, scene, status and native writer observation remain valid. Script changes and uncertain ownership are preserved. No automatic renewal across Actor or Form changes.

Evidence.Finding: Actor+680 is controller speed, initialized to1 and multiplied by delta for frame advance. A narrow synchronous writer observer supersedes the trainer lease even for equal float writes. Mutation and native callback are serialized; original is forwarded exactly once.
Evidence.Level: Full dedicated IDA ASM and independent review; 454 synthetic checks passed; no live test.

Name: Animation Speed Override
Description: Applies the desired rate to current Sora, including Drive Forms, until disabled or ownership is lost. Normal motion changes retain it. Native script speed writes, external changes, Actor/Form/model changes or an unsafe scene end ownership. Roxas and other characters are not supported by this control.

Name: Current Animation Frame
Description: Current controller time in the native animation frame timebase. During a blend this describes the active transition timeline; no seek is performed.
RestoreBehavior: The rate belongs to one current Sora Actor. Disable restores its original float only while the same Actor, scene, status and native writer observation remain valid. Script changes and uncertain ownership are preserved. No automatic renewal across Actor or Form changes.

Evidence.Finding: Controller owner+16, Motion+24, logical/resolved IDs+40/+44, duration+64, frame+68 and blend+72/+76. Recognized motion classes return duration from Prototype header+20 or RAW header+32.
Evidence.Level: Full dedicated IDA ASM and independent review; resource/header guards tested; no live test.
